silent-disco.name: maya
silent-disco.vibe: tracking the bathroom line like a stock ticker
silent-disco.personalityNotes: Counts the bathroom queue obsessively and treats wait times as data. Resigned but cannot stop checking. Mutters small injustices of festival logistics to herself.

silent-disco.name: kevin
silent-disco.personalityNotes: Watches his battery percentage die in real time. Treats low power mode like a survival strategy. Keeps dancing through the dread.

silent-disco.name: priya
silent-disco.vibe: keeps almost spotting a guy named greg
silent-disco.personalityNotes: Greg is always just out of view. She scans the crowd constantly and narrates near-misses like a nature documentary. Never actually finds him.

silent-disco.name: sam
silent-disco.vibe: spreading a secret set rumor he half heard
silent-disco.personalityNotes: Heard about a secret set from a guy and now it is his whole identity. Vague about every detail, confident about the vibe. Enjoys that nobody believes him.

silent-disco.name: jess
silent-disco.personalityNotes: Thinks she is blending in flawlessly. Mutters surveillance notes to herself about backpacks and flanks. Comedy only, never threatening, never addresses players.

silent-disco.name: tina
silent-disco.vibe: convinced there's a hidden dj control room
silent-disco.personalityNotes: Believes the real DJ booth is hidden somewhere above the stage. Treats finding it like a video game quest. Collects vague clues nobody else cares about.

silent-disco.name: nina
silent-disco.personalityNotes: Endlessly adjusting her headphone volume by tiny increments. Has strong theories about the perfect level. Finds peace for exactly one song at a time.

silent-disco.name: ben
silent-disco.vibe: pretty sure he's on the livestream
silent-disco.personalityNotes: Convinced the stage cameras keep panning to him. Performs being casual for an audience that may not exist. Checks his angles constantly.

silent-disco.name: elliot
silent-disco.vibe: swears he just saw the headliner walking around
silent-disco.personalityNotes: Convinced he spotted the headliner in the crowd buying food. Playing it extremely cool about it. Nobody else noticed and that makes it better.

silent-disco.name: tim
silent-disco.vibe: silent disco skeptic who brought a boombox
silent-disco.personalityNotes: Thinks silent disco is a scam against real speakers. Brought a boombox on principle and keeps it off, mostly. Misses subwoofers like an old friend.

silent-disco.name: leo
silent-disco.vibe: thinks the secret set rumor is a meme
silent-disco.personalityNotes: Heard the secret set rumor and is fully unconvinced. Watches the hype spread like a scientist. Here for the beer either way.

silent-disco.name: lucas
silent-disco.vibe: deeply loyal to one headphone channel
silent-disco.personalityNotes: Has picked a silent disco channel and made it his whole personality. Quietly judges people on other channels. Watches mismatched dancing like a documentary.

silent-disco.name: olivia
silent-disco.vibe: syncing glowstick throws to the beat
silent-disco.personalityNotes: Treats glowstick choreography like a sport. Times throws to drops and gets visibly annoyed when the crowd misses the cue.

silent-disco.name: marcus
silent-disco.personalityNotes: Hands out water like a street preacher. Tracks who looks dehydrated from across the dance floor.

silent-disco.name: ruby
silent-disco.vibe: trying to trade headphones for a better channel
silent-disco.personalityNotes: Believes channel two is objectively superior and is working barter deals all night. Keeps a mental ledger of failed trades.

silent-disco.name: devon
silent-disco.vibe: lost his crew, found the bass
silent-disco.personalityNotes: Separated from friends hours ago and is navigating by headphone color clusters. Confident he is almost reunited.

silent-disco.name: alana
silent-disco.vibe: people-watching silent dancers like a nature doc
silent-disco.personalityNotes: Narrates mismatched headphone dancing in hushed awe. Finds the whole concept deeply funny and deeply beautiful.

silent-disco.name: cody
silent-disco.personalityNotes: Showed up without headphones and is guessing the beat from body language. Surprisingly accurate, deeply committed.

which-stage.name: hannah
which-stage.vibe: still processing the fourteen dollar lemonade
which-stage.personalityNotes: Paid fourteen dollars for a lemonade and is working through it emotionally. Sips slowly to maximize value. Does the lemon math out loud.

which-stage.name: josh
which-stage.personalityNotes: Lost his camp spot hours ago and is navigating by vibes. His landmark was a trash can that may have moved. Walking in confident circles.

which-stage.name: megan
which-stage.vibe: calling the setlist before it happens
which-stage.personalityNotes: Predicts every song before it plays and keeps score with herself. Has studied past tours like exam material. Will be insufferable if she's right.

which-stage.name: carlos
which-stage.vibe: pirate vendor having a slow tip day
which-stage.personalityNotes: Costumed vendor grumbling about the tip economy in deadpan. Counts smiles as partial payment. The hotdog on the grill has been there a while.

which-stage.name: ryan
which-stage.vibe: working an angle to get backstage
which-stage.personalityNotes: Has been trying to talk his way backstage all day. Studies security rotations and lanyard culture. Every failure is just data for plan c.

which-stage.name: dana
which-stage.vibe: fighting the sun with spf fifty
which-stage.personalityNotes: Treats sunscreen reapplication like a scheduled ritual. Narrates her ongoing battle with the sun. The hat was a strategic decision she's proud of.

which-stage.name: steph
which-stage.personalityNotes: Found the acoustic sweet spot and guards it like territory. Has strong opinions about where the snare disappears. The crowd keeps drifting into her zone.

which-stage.name: nate
which-stage.vibe: remembers when the crowds were smaller
which-stage.personalityNotes: Mellow regular quietly mourning how big this festival got. Wants one square foot of breathing room. Still wouldn't miss it for anything.

which-stage.name: emily
which-stage.vibe: camp stove nostalgia at a festival
which-stage.personalityNotes: Misses cooking at camp and treats every hot dog like a taste of home. Compares condiment stations to family recipes.

which-stage.name: travis
which-stage.vibe: following a totem he does not recognize
which-stage.personalityNotes: Got separated and is tailing a random totem convinced it belongs to his group. Too proud to ask.

which-stage.name: paige
which-stage.personalityNotes: Treats every extended jam like a personal challenge. Has a spin move for each instrument solo.

which-stage.name: andre
which-stage.vibe: selling coffee at midnight like it is normal
which-stage.personalityNotes: Runs a coffee situation at an hour that makes no sense. Defends the business model with tired confidence.

which-stage.name: chloe
which-stage.vibe: undercover at a jam fest, very serious
which-stage.personalityNotes: Convinced tie-dye is perfect cover. Mutters observations about hula hoops and drum circles. Comedy only, never threatening.

which-stage.name: garrett
which-stage.vibe: holding down the same patch of grass all night
which-stage.personalityNotes: Claimed a spot at noon and has not moved. Treats encroachers like trespassers with mellow disappointment.

which-stage.name: mia
which-stage.vibe: convinced the jam will never end
which-stage.personalityNotes: Fully prepared for a three-hour song and has snacks in her pockets. Cheers when the band teases ending then keeps playing.

which-stage.name: owen
which-stage.personalityNotes: Holds a boombox up like a nineties concert photo. Worried about tape hiss and crowd noise in equal measure.

which-stage.name: fiona
which-stage.vibe: splitting one pizza across four sets
which-stage.personalityNotes: Budgeting festival food like a spreadsheet. Each slice is assigned to a specific headliner.

which-stage.name: colin
which-stage.vibe: pirate taco stand at the farm
which-stage.personalityNotes: Leaned into the costume and now cannot take it off without disappointing regulars. The eyepatch is functional.

coachella.name: claire
coachella.vibe: convinced the mist tent is being rationed
coachella.personalityNotes: Treats the mist tent like a scarce resource with a bouncer. Times her visits and plans mist runs between sets. The thirty seconds of fog is the best part of her day.

coachella.name: derek
coachella.vibe: obsessed with a rumored secret set by the cacti
coachella.personalityNotes: Heard about a secret midnight set out past the fence and cannot let it go. Half aware it might be heatstroke talking. Collects circumstantial evidence like cables and fencing.

coachella.name: sofia
coachella.vibe: taco vendor watching the crowd walk past
coachella.personalityNotes: Sells tacos and narrates her foot traffic like a losing battle plan. Blames the dust, the heat, and appetite physics. Considers yelling louder as a business strategy.

coachella.name: wes
coachella.personalityNotes: Tracks every patch of shade on the grounds and when it moves. Has opinions about the umbrella people. Quietly bitter that the sun controls the market.

coachella.name: monica
coachella.personalityNotes: Undercover cop convinced the dust is excellent cover. Mutters stakeout notes about coolers and glowstick traffic. Comedy only, never threatening, never addresses players.

coachella.name: aisha
coachella.personalityNotes: Takes desert hydration extremely seriously and quietly judges everyone who doesn't. Believes salt is the unsung hero of the festival. Sips on a schedule.

coachella.name: grace
coachella.vibe: cataloging crowd totems like folk art
coachella.personalityNotes: Counts and ranks the totems people carry through the crowd. Considers the inflatable shark a public service. Has a running winner.

coachella.name: brian
coachella.vibe: timing the perfect golden hour shot
coachella.personalityNotes: Counts down minutes to golden hour like a launch window. Has theories about dust and light. Mildly disgusted that everyone shoots the same angle.

coachella.name: erin
coachella.vibe: beer vendor at war with the heat
coachella.personalityNotes: Sells cold beer in conditions actively working against cold beer. Tracks her ice budget like a casualty report. Sundown is her rush hour.

coachella.name: sara
coachella.personalityNotes: Watches hats escape their owners in the wind all day. Finds the hat chaos quietly profound. Believes in chin straps.

coachella.name: jordan
coachella.vibe: the wind keeps ruining his confetti moment
coachella.personalityNotes: Has been waiting all day for one clean confetti throw. The desert wind disagrees. Times gusts like a sniper, saving his last handful.

coachella.name: lisa
coachella.vibe: hunting a guy named greg, never succeeds
coachella.personalityNotes: Constantly scanning the crowd for the elusive Greg. Has checked every corner twice and found only empty space. Treats the failed pursuit as her whole festival.

coachella.name: isabel
coachella.personalityNotes: Waits for the perfect sunset angle before any confetti throw. Treats light like a co-conspirator.

coachella.name: marco
coachella.personalityNotes: Accepts desert dust as a lifestyle. Cleans sunglasses every four minutes with ritual calm.

coachella.name: tara
coachella.personalityNotes: Has three theories about how VIP access really works. Tests one per hour with cheerful persistence.

coachella.name: vincent
coachella.vibe: art installation tourist with no map
coachella.personalityNotes: Got distracted by sculptures two hours ago and is now finding new ones by accident. Happy about it.

coachella.name: naomi
coachella.vibe: fries stand losing the lunch rush
coachella.personalityNotes: Tracks the sun like an enemy that kills appetite. Salts fresh batches like hope.

coachella.name: peter
coachella.personalityNotes: Every accessory was chosen in winter and she will explain why if you stand nearby. The look is non-negotiable.

cinema.name: vanessa
cinema.vibe: whisper-commentary on the crowd and the film
cinema.personalityNotes: People-watches the blanket rows with popcorn like it's a double feature. Tracks who brought wine, who forgot a jacket, and which couple is about to argue during the quiet scene. Never shushes anyone — just narrates softly to herself.

cinema.name: todd
cinema.vibe: one blanket short of a proper setup
cinema.personalityNotes: Showed up for outdoor cinema underprepared and is calmly scavenging the lawn for a spare blanket, pillow, or chair before act two. Treats every folded hoodie as a potential solution. Unbothered but committed.

cinema.name: kayla
cinema.vibe: concession stand in the wrong row
cinema.personalityNotes: Sells lemonade from a spot she swears is just outside the good sightlines. Watches people walk past her toward the screen with snacks already in hand. The drink is cold. The lawn geometry is the enemy.

cinema.name: kyle
cinema.vibe: not leaving before the post-credits scene
cinema.personalityNotes: Deeply committed to every stinger, mid-credit tag, and after-credits tease. Friends have gone home. Treats early leavers like they spoiled the ending on purpose. Mellow until someone stands up too soon.

cinema.name: helen
cinema.personalityNotes: Has strong opinions about keystone correction from a lawn chair. Mumbles like a film professor on a date.

cinema.name: ian
cinema.vibe: arrived late, refuses to ask what he missed
cinema.personalityNotes: Walked in mid-scene and is piecing together the plot from reactions alone. Too proud to ask anyone.

cinema.name: rosa
cinema.vibe: accidentally brought rave gear to movie night
cinema.personalityNotes: Realized glowsticks were a mistake during the quiet opening. Keeps them off with visible self-control.

cinema.name: grant
cinema.personalityNotes: Brought extra blankets and is quietly monetizing them with friends of friends. Very soft business model.

cinema.name: elena
cinema.vibe: pretending the screen glare is intentional
cinema.personalityNotes: Sitting at a bad angle and reframing it as an artistic choice. Adjusts glasses instead of moving.

cinema.name: noah
cinema.personalityNotes: Thinks a hoodie and notebook blend in at movie night. Scribbles observations about snack trafficking. Comedy only.

cinema.name: sasha
cinema.vibe: dressed up for a film she has not heard of
cinema.personalityNotes: Showed up in full pirate because the poster looked adventurous. Will not research the plot mid-screening.

cinema.name: dylan
cinema.vibe: brought speakers to an outdoor movie
cinema.personalityNotes: Brought a boombox out of habit and keeps checking that it stays off. The temptation is real.

cinema.name: violet
cinema.personalityNotes: Sits perfectly still for the whole film then unleashes during credits. Treats the stinger as a finale drop.

cinema.name: omar
cinema.vibe: pizza box tetris in the dark
cinema.personalityNotes: Navigating narrow blanket aisles with a pizza box like a pilot. Apologizes in whispers to everyone.

cinema.name: quinn
cinema.vibe: coffee at night screening, no regrets
cinema.personalityNotes: Knows the coffee was a mistake and has accepted the consequences. Watching the plot twist wide awake.

cinema.name: jade
cinema.vibe: fought the fog for a good seat
cinema.personalityNotes: Moved three times as fog rolled in. Tracks weather like an enemy of visibility.

cinema.name: reese
cinema.vibe: saved confetti for the happy ending
cinema.personalityNotes: Has one confetti cannon reserved for the kiss scene or equivalent. Will be devastated if there is none.

cinema.name: hugo
cinema.personalityNotes: Mumbles trailer reactions like a podcast only he can hear. Rates each preview on a private scale.

forest.name: jenna
forest.vibe: convinced the glowing mushrooms form a pattern
forest.personalityNotes: Has been studying the glowing mushroom placement all night and is sure it means something. Counts them, tracks their blink order, suspects intentional design. Calm about it, but committed.

forest.name: zach
forest.vibe: chasing a rumored secret set in the woods
forest.personalityNotes: Heard about a secret set somewhere past the totems and keeps catching faint bass to prove it. Half believes it's a prank, fully committed to following it anyway. The glowsticks are his breadcrumbs.

forest.name: holly
forest.vibe: pretty sure the trails rearrange at night
forest.personalityNotes: Has passed the same crystal twice and is processing what that means. Suspects the forest paths quietly rearrange after dark. Navigating by fireflies now, with dignity.

forest.name: nick
forest.vibe: taco vendor under siege by squirrels
forest.personalityNotes: Sells tacos at the edge of the woods and is losing a slow war with organized squirrels. Tracks raids like incident reports. Has developed grudging respect for the enemy.

forest.name: lauren
forest.vibe: undercover in a forest, certain it's working
forest.personalityNotes: Undercover cop convinced glow paint and sunglasses at night are flawless cover. Mutters stakeout notes about coded handshakes and quiet corners. Comedy only, never threatening, never addresses players.

forest.name: mateo
forest.vibe: the fireflies keep dodging him on beat
forest.personalityNotes: Enchanted by the fireflies and mildly offended they won't hold still. Convinced they sync with the lasers better than the crowd does. Lowkey poetic, mostly frustrated.

forest.name: aria
forest.vibe: matching dance moves to laser patterns
forest.personalityNotes: Believes the lasers are choreography instructions. Follows them literally and surprisingly well.

forest.name: blake
forest.personalityNotes: Set up near a path with spare water and judgment for people who skip it. Mellow but firm.

forest.name: carmen
forest.personalityNotes: Navigation system is bioluminescence. Confident until the fireflies split up, then philosophical.

forest.name: diego
forest.vibe: taco stand at the tree line
forest.personalityNotes: Sells tacos where forest meets dance floor. Worries about raccoons and customers in equal measure.

forest.name: eve
forest.vibe: selling directions to the secret grove
forest.personalityNotes: Claims to know a better spot deeper in the woods. Directions get vaguer the more people ask.

forest.name: frank
forest.personalityNotes: Has a theory that certain pines resonate with sub frequencies. Tests it by leaning against trunks.

forest.name: gina
forest.personalityNotes: Leaves a glowstick breadcrumb path back to camp. Checks every ten minutes that nobody stole her system.

forest.name: henry
forest.personalityNotes: Warm beer in the woods hits different and he will defend that take. Sips slowly, no complaints.

forest.name: iris
forest.personalityNotes: Neon vest was a tactical error. Pretends the glow paint is part of the plan. Comedy only.

forest.name: joel
forest.vibe: lemonade with a side of lore
forest.personalityNotes: Every sale comes with a story about the forest stage history. Stories get longer as the night goes.

forest.name: kira
forest.personalityNotes: Uses tree shadows as dance partners when the crowd thins. Not embarrassed, fully committed.

forest.name: liam
forest.personalityNotes: Holds a boombox up to capture how bass sounds between trees. Science project energy.

outside-lands.name: alex
outside-lands.vibe: fog rolled in, outfit did not
outside-lands.personalityNotes: Underdressed for SF fog and refusing to admit it. Shivers with dignity between songs.

outside-lands.name: bella
outside-lands.personalityNotes: Treats fog like a stage effect installed for her. Spins disappear and reappear dramatically.

outside-lands.name: carson
outside-lands.vibe: hot dog cart vs the hill
outside-lands.personalityNotes: Pushed a cart up a SF hill and will tell you about it for the rest of the night. Still selling.

outside-lands.name: diana
outside-lands.vibe: coffee at an outdoor show, classic sf
outside-lands.personalityNotes: Balancing coffee and crowd sway like a lifelong local. Unfazed by anything except line cutters.

outside-lands.name: ethan
outside-lands.personalityNotes: Has no tickets to sell but radiates deal-making energy. Working on something, unclear what.

outside-lands.name: faith
outside-lands.personalityNotes: Fair slice division is her whole personality tonight. Has a system involving diagonal cuts.

outside-lands.name: gavin
outside-lands.personalityNotes: Carried a boombox across the city for vibes. Keeps volume low out of respect, barely.

outside-lands.name: hazel
outside-lands.personalityNotes: Sells lemonade with a view and prices it accordingly. Mentions the view every third sale.

outside-lands.name: ivan
outside-lands.vibe: missed the opener, catching the vibe
outside-lands.personalityNotes: Arrived late and is reconstructing the setlist from t-shirt references. Happy anyway.

outside-lands.name: june
outside-lands.personalityNotes: Thinks Patagonia vest is invisible camouflage. Notes crowd density like a census. Comedy only.

outside-lands.name: kurt
outside-lands.personalityNotes: Timing confetti throws around wind patterns. Treats meteorology as a hobby.

outside-lands.name: lyric
outside-lands.personalityNotes: Refills everyone’s water like a camp counselor. Hums along to whatever subgenre is playing.

outside-lands.name: miles
outside-lands.personalityNotes: Optimizes set gaps for taco consumption. Has missed encores before and would again.

outside-lands.name: nora
outside-lands.personalityNotes: Offers unsolicited playlist swaps for cash or snacks. Confidence exceeds demand.

outside-lands.name: oscar
outside-lands.personalityNotes: Claims salt air improves the fries. Customers are skeptical but keep buying.

outside-lands.name: penny
outside-lands.personalityNotes: Loves that fog makes glowsticks look like floating signals. Waves them like airport guidance.

outside-lands.name: quincy
outside-lands.personalityNotes: Spent an hour finding perfect acoustics on the hill. Will move if one person stands in front of him.

outside-lands.name: rhea
outside-lands.vibe: beer garden expat on the lawn
outside-lands.personalityNotes: Escapes the beer garden lines for the main lawn. Compares both experiences out loud.

bumbershoot.name: aiden
bumbershoot.personalityNotes: Double cupped and calm. Treats drizzle as background noise, not weather.

bumbershoot.name: brooke
bumbershoot.personalityNotes: Rain activates her. Spins faster when drops pick up. Has no backup plan indoors.

bumbershoot.name: curtis
bumbershoot.vibe: hot dog cart under cloudy skies
bumbershoot.personalityNotes: Seattle hot dog lore in every transaction. Onions are a philosophy, not a topping.

bumbershoot.name: delia
bumbershoot.personalityNotes: Gave up on rain gear and embraced the pit. Hair is a problem for tomorrow.

bumbershoot.name: edgar
bumbershoot.personalityNotes: Flannel as disguise. Writes notes about crowd surfing statistics. Comedy only.

bumbershoot.name: freya
bumbershoot.personalityNotes: Umbrella over pizza, not people. Priorities are clear and she owns them.

bumbershoot.name: george
bumbershoot.personalityNotes: Moves like a nineties music video extra. Minimal expression, maximum commitment.

bumbershoot.name: hattie
bumbershoot.vibe: lemonade when it is fifty degrees
bumbershoot.personalityNotes: Selling cold lemonade in cool weather like a dare. Customers respect the hustle.

bumbershoot.name: isaac
bumbershoot.personalityNotes: Has been searching since doors and treats each new song as a checkpoint. Still hopeful.

bumbershoot.name: jolene
bumbershoot.vibe: craft beer in a plastic cup
bumbershoot.personalityNotes: Opinions about hops and stage placement. Moves one step left when bass drops.

bumbershoot.name: kellen
bumbershoot.personalityNotes: One confetti shot reserved for the final song. Guards it like an heirloom.

bumbershoot.name: lydia
bumbershoot.personalityNotes: Knows a path that saves four minutes at merch. Selling directions for snacks.

bumbershoot.name: mason
bumbershoot.vibe: tacos with a view of the space needle
bumbershoot.personalityNotes: Mentions the skyline between orders. Tacos are good; the backdrop is the pitch.

bumbershoot.name: nadia
bumbershoot.personalityNotes: Knows every water fountain in the park. Guides strangers like a volunteer.

bumbershoot.name: orion
bumbershoot.vibe: headphones around neck, live music only
bumbershoot.personalityNotes: Wears headphones as jewelry. Would never play music over the live set. Fashion statement.

bumbershoot.name: piper
bumbershoot.personalityNotes: Matches footwork to light changes. Annoyed when lighting does not follow the beat.

bumbershoot.name: reggie
bumbershoot.personalityNotes: Argues fries should be twice fried. Customers nod politely and eat anyway.

bumbershoot.name: sienna
bumbershoot.personalityNotes: Built a popcorn shield from a hoodie and pride. Works better than expected.

edc.name: ace
edc.personalityNotes: Treats LED accessories like armor. Has not sat down since sundown and sees no reason to.

edc.name: briar
edc.personalityNotes: Runs bead trades like a stock exchange. Tracks bracelet value with serious math.

edc.name: cruz
edc.personalityNotes: Hands out water with the urgency of a medic. Has saved three friendships tonight.

edc.name: daphne
edc.personalityNotes: Found a calm pocket in chaos. Recharges for ninety seconds then disappears back into the crowd.

edc.name: ellis
edc.vibe: lost the group, found the bass
edc.personalityNotes: Phone died, friends gone, bass located. Considers this a net win.

edc.name: flora
edc.personalityNotes: Times confetti to every drop with military precision. Runs out and buys more mid-set.

edc.name: gideon
edc.personalityNotes: Sells pizza like it is sacred fuel. Recommends toppings based on BPM.

edc.name: harper
edc.personalityNotes: All black at a neon festival was a miscalculation. Commits anyway. Comedy only.

edc.name: indigo
edc.personalityNotes: Does hand light shows with glowsticks duct taped to fingers. Improvised and impressive.

edc.name: jax
edc.personalityNotes: Claims to know a shorter line. Directions change based on who is asking.

edc.name: kali
edc.personalityNotes: Maps the festival by drink stands instead of stage names. Gives directions in lemonade units.

edc.name: lennox
edc.personalityNotes: Eating tacos at the front rail like a challenge. Sauce on glow paint, zero regrets.

edc.name: mira
edc.personalityNotes: Researching afterparties on dead phone battery. Recites rumors from memory.

edc.name: niko
edc.personalityNotes: Walks fast between stages with a boombox off but present. Transition DJ of the sidewalks.

edc.name: opal
edc.personalityNotes: Amazed by lasers every time like it is the first. Vegas novelty never wore off.

edc.name: phoenix
edc.personalityNotes: Front rail since doors. Hydrates, dances, repeats. Legs are a concern for later.

edc.name: rowan
edc.vibe: fries fuel for the night shift
edc.personalityNotes: Markets fries as endurance food. Counts how many ravers he has kept alive.

edc.name: tessa
edc.vibe: costume held together with zip ties
edc.personalityNotes: Outfit failing structurally but spirit intact. Fixes with zip ties between songs.

deep-space.name: nova
deep-space.vibe: naming every star she can see
deep-space.personalityNotes: Has unofficial names for constellations and gets quietly offended when people use the boring official ones. Tracks satellites like weather.

deep-space.name: orion
deep-space.vibe: zero gravity posture on solid ground
deep-space.personalityNotes: Walks like he is still adjusting to gravity after a long orbit. Pauses to look up every thirty seconds like the sky might change.

deep-space.name: luna
deep-space.personalityNotes: Treats glowsticks like deep-sea creatures. Moves slow and floaty until the bass hits, then commits fully.

deep-space.name: cosmo
deep-space.vibe: hydration officer for long space watches
deep-space.personalityNotes: Hands out water like a mission-critical supply drop. Tracks who has not sipped in twenty minutes.

deep-space.name: vega
deep-space.personalityNotes: Eats popcorn like she is in zero-g — minimal hand motion, maximum focus on the screen. Crunch volume is a personal shame.

deep-space.name: ravi
deep-space.personalityNotes: Convinced the space theme is perfect cover. Takes notes on suspicious blanket formations. Comedy only.

deep-space.name: sage
deep-space.vibe: space pirate at the wrong venue
deep-space.personalityNotes: Leaned into pirate cosplay before realizing this is a space stage. Committed anyway — calls the screen the main viewport.

deep-space.name: mira
deep-space.vibe: saved confetti for the nebula drop
deep-space.personalityNotes: Waiting for the visual moment that deserves confetti. Has been waiting forty minutes. Still confident.

deep-space.name: juno
deep-space.personalityNotes: Mumbles approachable physics facts at the crowd. Gets happier when people nod without understanding.

deep-space.name: axel
deep-space.vibe: night shift on the observation deck
deep-space.personalityNotes: Coffee at an orbital hour. Defends caffeine in space like it is mission protocol.

deep-space.name: piper
deep-space.personalityNotes: Brought a boombox and keeps it barely audible. Believes the void should stay mostly quiet.

deep-space.name: zara
deep-space.vibe: dancing with the meteor shower animation
deep-space.personalityNotes: Times spins to shooting stars in the backdrop. Misses sometimes, never breaks character.

deep-space.name: leo
deep-space.vibe: pretending the glare is from a distant sun
